hero.headline: Non-Destructive Testing & Welding Inspection in Argentina
hero.subtitle: GF Inspecciones y Ensayos provides specialized NDT and Welding Inspection services, with Level 2 personnel qualified per IRAM-ISO 9712. Quality, safety, and integrity in every project.

about.label: About Us
about.title: About GF Inspecciones y Ensayos
about.description: GF Inspecciones y Ensayos is a company specialized in Non-Destructive Testing and Welding Inspection, based in Buenos Aires, Argentina. We have Level 2 personnel qualified and authorized per IRAM-ISO 9712 requirements, committed to the highest standards of quality and safety. Our focus is on delivering reliable, traceable, and timely results that support our clients' technical decisions.

0.title: Integrity
0.description: We conduct every inspection with honesty, transparency, and strict adherence to technical and ethical standards.

1.title: Precision
1.description: We apply rigorous procedures and techniques aligned with applicable standards to ensure reliable and reproducible results.

2.title: Quality
2.description: Level 2 personnel qualified per IRAM-ISO 9712, ensuring technical competence in every service we provide.

3.title: Safety
3.description: The safety of people, facilities, and the environment is our priority in every job.

services.title: Our Services
services.subtitle: Specialized Non-Destructive Testing and Welding Inspection services, focused on quality control, integrity assessment, and conformity verification.

ndt.title: Non-Destructive Testing (NDT)
ndt.description: Ultrasonic Testing (UT), Industrial Radiography (RT), Liquid Penetrant Testing (PT) and Magnetic Particle Testing (MT). We evaluate material integrity without affecting functionality.

radiografia.title: Industrial Radiography (RT)
radiografia.description: Evaluation of internal discontinuities in welded joints and components using X-ray radiation and radiographic film.

welding.title: Welding Inspection
welding.description: Control and monitoring during the various stages of the fabrication and assembly process, with Level 2 personnel per IRAM-ISO 9712.

calificacion.title: Welding Qualification
calificacion.description: Welder and welding operator qualification and welding procedure qualification (PQR/WPS) per applicable code or standard.

asesoramiento.title: Technical Advisory
asesoramiento.description: Specialized advisory in NDT, inspection, and welding. Technique selection, standard interpretation, and results evaluation.

pressure_vessel.title: Pressure Vessel Inspection
pressure_vessel.description: Inspection of pressure vessels, piping, and process systems per ASME, API codes, and Argentine regulations.

corrosion.title: Corrosion Assessment
corrosion.description: Ultrasonic wall thickness measurement, corrosion mapping, and degradation analysis. Remaining life estimation and mitigation strategies.

asset_integrity.title: Asset Integrity Management
asset_integrity.description: Risk-Based Inspection (RBI) plans, predictive maintenance, and technical consulting. Quality assurance and regulatory compliance.

laser_scanning.title: 3D Laser Scanning
laser_scanning.description: High-precision dimensional surveys, BIM modeling, deformation analysis, and reverse engineering for industrial plants.

projects.label: Projects
projects.title: Featured Projects
projects.subtitle: A selection of projects where we applied our expertise to ensure the integrity and safety of industrial installations.

petrochemical.title: Petrochemical Plant Inspection
petrochemical.description: Inspection of welded joints and components using Ultrasonic Testing, Industrial Radiography, and thickness measurement.

pipeline.title: Welding Control in Assembly
pipeline.description: Welding inspection and NDT coordination during fabrication and assembly of metal structures.

refinery.title: NDT on Industrial Equipment
refinery.description: Inspection using UT, RT, PT, and MT on components and welded joints during planned shutdown.
